# Everything emcool says over OBD-II, ported from cool-eva: the PID poller, the trouble-code
# reads over ISO-TP, the E-LOCK keys-paired read, and Energica's code table (generated by
# tools/generate-diagnostic-tables.mts). Transport-free; the firmware supplies the bus.
set(emcool_obd_sources
  src/dtc_table.cpp
  src/dtc_table.gen.cpp
  src/elock.cpp
  src/freeze_frame.cpp
  src/hub_diagnostics.cpp
  src/infokeys.gen.cpp
  src/iso_tp.cpp
  src/lifetime.cpp
  src/obd_dtc.cpp
  src/obd_hold.cpp
  src/obd_poller.cpp
  src/obd_stack.cpp
  src/static_bodies.gen.cpp
  src/stored_codes.cpp
  src/transmit_log.cpp
  src/trouble_code_reader.cpp
)

if(ESP_PLATFORM)
  idf_component_register(SRCS ${emcool_obd_sources} INCLUDE_DIRS include REQUIRES emcool_log emcool_text)
else()
  add_library(emcool_obd STATIC ${emcool_obd_sources})
  target_include_directories(emcool_obd PUBLIC include)
  target_link_libraries(emcool_obd PUBLIC emcool_log emcool_text)
endif()
